profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I’m passionate about sports, reading books, science and programming. I made my first steps in the programming world at the university of Alcala de Henares in Spain, making there a lot of progress working along with my teammates, improving my skills of how to code, develop projects, take requirements and server maintenance.
In all of the jobs that I’ve been working on, I’ve learned that the teamwork is essential in order to achieve the common goals. Also, good programming behaviors like make the code easy to read and easy to maintain are necessary. For me, this knowledge is the key for the set up of the project, and his correctly troubleshooting.
Another important aspect that I’ve learned from previous projects is that as a software developer I must be aware of how do we take the requirements from the client, his needs, and the future improvements and changes that may occur during and after the integration of the project.
Skills/interests: Java, Javascript, CSS, HTML, C, SQL, COBOL, Db2, ladder logic, PHP and all about Linux/Unix world.

positions.title: Senior Software developer
positions.description:
Falcon SCADA is a company that provides comprehensive monitoring services and online maintenance to oil companies operating in West Texas. During my time here, I worked on developing the frontend page that displays the services provided by the company. I also created AutoCAD schematics to illustrate the company's assets and the connectivity of the systems in the oilfield lease.

Most of the work I did for IROB was done remotely, but when I had to go to the field, I handled PLC installation and configuration, as well as checking the ModBus connections between the server and the PLC on site.

positions.title: Programador sénior
positions.description:
I worked there as a senior developer, doing maintentance works and data migrations. While i was there i upgrade my programming skills in COBOL, and an Object-Oriented languaje called HPS. I used mainframe enviroments as well as linux servers to solve the issues.
The main milestones archived there is to migrate the data of new bank companies to the servers of RSI.

positions.title: Junior developer
positions.description: I worked there as a junior developer, making new developments in Java and Javascript. During the time I spent there I improve my programming skills in all the ways I could, ranging from project management to software deployment
